evidenceOrRepro: The original ATM-GOV-0245 reproduction is covered by `node --strip-types tests/cli/claim-owner-mismatch-message.test.ts` and `node --strip-types tests/cli/lane-dual-session-e2e.test.ts`, both exited 0 on 2026-09-06. followUp: Keep the lane ownership matrix and stale-lane adoption regressions in the frozen runner. Any future mismatch wording change must preserve the distinction between actor identity and lane-session identity.
